name: lokalbot
description: LokalBot, your personal context engine, for Claude Code.

plugins.name: lokalbot
plugins.description: Your personal context engine. Claude Code reads your local LokalBot library on macOS, Windows, or Linux through lokalbot-cli: meetings and their action items, the people in them, the folders you chose under Files, and what you shared about yourself, each behind its own permission in LokalBot. Adds /lokalbot:brief, /lokalbot:recall, and /lokalbot:setup and the lokalbot-cli skill. With a separate permission, Claude can also check and change LokalBot's settings; changes that widen what LokalBot captures wait for your approval in the app.
